साई पल्लवी का यह वीडियो देखकर फैंस काफी हैरान रह गए थे, लेकिन अब सच सामने आ गया है! 😲

नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म Ramayana में सीता का किरदार निभा रहीं साई पल्लवी के दादाजी का एक वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर वायरल हुआ था। इस वायरल क्लिप में उनके दादाजी कहते दिखे थे कि साई पल्लवी ने Ramayana में कोई एक्टिंग नहीं की है।

अब Behindwoods के साथ इंटरव्यू में साई पल्लवी ने सफाई देते हुए पूरा सच बताया है। उन्होंने कहा कि वह वीडियो आधा काटकर दिखाया गया था। उनके दादाजी ने असल में कहा था, "मुझे नहीं लगता उसने एक्टिंग की, मुझे लगता है कि भगवान ने ही उसके जरिए काम किया है।"

एक्ट्रेस ने यह भी बताया कि जब उन्हें यह रोल ऑफर हुआ था तो सबसे पहले उन्होंने अपने दादा-दादी को बताया था। फिल्म में रणबीर कपूर भगवान राम और यश रावण के रोल में हैं, जिसका पार्ट 1 आ चुका है और पार्ट 2 Diwali 2028 में आएगा।

क्या आपको भी लगता है कि साई पल्लवी इस रोल में बिल्कुल फिट बैठती हैं? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 🙏✨

ctx.title: Sai Pallavi reveals her grandfather’s reaction to her portrayal of Sita, says he thinks ‘God acted through her’ in Ramayana
ctx.summary: After a video of her grandfather saying she did not act in Ramayana circulated online, Sai Pallavi explained that the clip omitted his full meaning.
ctx.text:
Sai Pallavi has been receiving praise for her portrayal of Sita in Ramayana . While fans have lauded her performance, a video of her grandfather reacting to her role in the film has also been doing the rounds on social media. In the clip, he appears to say that Sai Pallavi did not act in Ramayana. The actor has now clarified what he meant, revealing the complete context behind his statement.
In an interview with Behindwoods, Pallavi addressed the video in which her grandfather was heard saying, “Sai Pallavi did not act in Ramayana.” She explained that the clip had been cut short, leaving out the context of his statement. Revealing what he had actually said, the actor clarified, “But actually he replied, 'I don't think she acted, I think it was God only has acted through her'.”
In an earlier interview with BritAsia TV, Pallavi spoke about growing up in a family where her grandparents would often refer to her and the other children as gods and goddesses. She said, “I grew up in a household where my grandparents would call us gods and goddesses. So when we did something wrong, they would say, 'You are a goddess, you should not do this.' That is a lot of added pressure.”
Recalling how her grandparents reacted when she was offered the role of Sita, Pallavi said they were among the first people she shared the news with. “But when I was offered the role, the first people I told about this was my grandparents. They were really happy,” she added.
Pallavi has also spoken about why playing a goddess is not an easy task. At a promotional event for the film in July, she said, “It’s not easy for actors to get roles like this. Because it’s not easy to play a Goddess. There must be a team putting their heart and soul into making it the best version. I don’t think I chose to play Sita maa. I was blessed to play this role. It’s not something that you can go after and not something you can write down and say, this is how I want to play. I would sit and meditate and say, Sita maa, you act through me. Whatever comes through me is what you want for the film.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The first part released in theatres on November 5, while the second part is slated for a Diwali 2028 release.
